ONE POINT OF VIEWMORE WAYS TO MAKE IT MATTER
THE THROUGHLINE

A good idea should
hold together.

Every brief is different. These are the questions that help the thinking and the making stay connected.

  1. 01
    UNDERSTAND

    What are we really trying to change?

    Get clear on the ambition, the people you want to reach and the challenge worth solving.

  2. 02
    DEFINE

    What makes it yours?

    Find the point of view that can guide your words, visuals and creative choices.

  3. 03
    MAKE

    How does it show up?

    Give that idea a life through the right mix of content, social media and campaigns.

  4. 04
    REFINE

    What is connecting?

    See how people respond and use what you learn to make the next move sharper.

There is no fixed entry point. A single question is enough to begin.
